dataStream.name: devices
dataStream.sql: SELECT "name" AS "device", "onlineStatus" AS "health", CONCAT_WS(' · ', NULLIF(TRIM(COALESCE("vendorName", '') || ' ' || COALESCE("makeModel", '')), ''), CASE WHEN "deviceType" = 'ups' THEN 'UPS' WHEN "deviceType" IS NULL OR "deviceType" = 'unknown' THEN 'Unclassified' ELSE UPPER(SUBSTR(REGEXP_REPLACE("deviceType", '([A-Z])', ' \1', 'g'), 1, 1)) || SUBSTR(REGEXP_REPLACE("deviceType", '([A-Z])', ' \1', 'g'), 2) END, NULLIF(SPLIT_PART("ipAddresses", ',', 1), '')) AS "summary", "link" FROM "dataset"

dataStream.name: interfaces
dataStream.sql: SELECT REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE("name", 'TenGigabitEthernet', 'Te'), 'GigabitEthernet', 'Gi'), 'FastEthernet', 'Fa'), 'Port-channel', 'Po') AS "port", CASE "operationalStatus[Expanded].rawState" WHEN 'online' THEN 'Up' WHEN 'adminDown' THEN 'Disabled' ELSE 'Down' END AS "state", CASE WHEN "operationalStatus[Expanded].rawState" = 'adminDown' THEN 'Disabled' WHEN "operationalStatus[Expanded].rawState" <> 'online' OR "operationalStatus[Expanded].rawState" IS NULL THEN 'Down' ELSE COALESCE(CASE WHEN "negotiatedSpeed" >= 1000 THEN CAST(CAST("negotiatedSpeed" / 1000 AS INTEGER) AS VARCHAR) || ' Gbps' WHEN "negotiatedSpeed" > 0 THEN CAST(CAST("negotiatedSpeed" AS INTEGER) AS VARCHAR) || ' Mbps' END, 'Up') END AS "detail", CAST(ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY CASE WHEN "interfaceType" = 'ethernet' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END, LENGTH("name"), "name") AS DOUBLE) AS "position", "link" FROM "dataset" WHERE COALESCE("operationalStatus[Expanded].rawState", '') <> 'notPresent' ORDER BY "position"

config.description: Every interface on this device at a glance: green is up, grey is down, dark is disabled. Click a port to open it in Auvik
config.title: Port Map

dataStream.name: devices
dataStream.sql: SELECT COALESCE("vendorName", '—') AS "vendor", COALESCE("makeModel", '—') AS "model", CASE WHEN "deviceType" = 'ups' THEN 'UPS' WHEN "deviceType" IS NULL OR "deviceType" = 'unknown' THEN 'Unclassified' ELSE UPPER(SUBSTR(REGEXP_REPLACE("deviceType", '([A-Z])', ' \1', 'g'), 1, 1)) || SUBSTR(REGEXP_REPLACE("deviceType", '([A-Z])', ' \1', 'g'), 2) END AS "type", NULLIF("ipAddresses", '') AS "ips", COALESCE("serialNumber", '—') AS "serial", COALESCE("softwareVersion", '—') AS "software", COALESCE("firmwareVersion", '—') AS "firmware", COALESCE(UPPER(SUBSTR("snmpStatus[Expanded].rawState", 1, 1)) || LOWER(SUBSTR(REGEXP_REPLACE("snmpStatus[Expanded].rawState", '([A-Z])', ' \1', 'g'), 2)), 'Not configured') AS "snmp", "managed", "tenantName" AS "site" FROM "dataset"

config.description: Identity, software and management details Auvik holds for this device
config.title: Device Details

dataStream.name: interfaces
dataStream.sql: SELECT CASE "operationalStatus[Expanded].rawState" WHEN 'online' THEN 'Up' WHEN 'adminDown' THEN 'Disabled' WHEN 'notPresent' THEN 'Not present' ELSE 'Down' END AS "state", "name" AS "port", CASE "interfaceType" WHEN 'virtualNic' THEN 'Virtual NIC' WHEN 'rs232' THEN 'RS-232' WHEN 'ieee80211' THEN 'Wi-Fi' WHEN 'ppp' THEN 'PPP' WHEN 'l2vlan' THEN 'L2 VLAN' WHEN 'l3vlan' THEN 'L3 VLAN' WHEN 'vlan' THEN 'VLAN' WHEN 'wifi' THEN 'Wi-Fi' WHEN 'cdma' THEN 'CDMA' ELSE UPPER(SUBSTR(REGEXP_REPLACE(COALESCE("interfaceType", 'unknown'), '([A-Z])', ' \1', 'g'), 1, 1)) || SUBSTR(REGEXP_REPLACE(COALESCE("interfaceType", 'unknown'), '([A-Z])', ' \1', 'g'), 2) END AS "type", CASE WHEN "negotiatedSpeed" >= 1000 THEN CAST(CAST("negotiatedSpeed" / 1000 AS INTEGER) AS VARCHAR) || ' Gbps' WHEN "negotiatedSpeed" > 0 THEN CAST(CAST("negotiatedSpeed" AS INTEGER) AS VARCHAR) || ' Mbps' END AS "speed", CASE WHEN "duplex" IS NULL OR "duplex" = 'unknown' THEN NULL ELSE UPPER(SUBSTR("duplex", 1, 1)) || SUBSTR("duplex", 2) END AS "duplex", NULLIF("ipAddresses", '') AS "ips", NULLIF("networkNames", '') AS "networks", "macAddress" AS "mac", CAST(COALESCE("connectedTo", 0) AS DOUBLE) AS "neighbours", "link" FROM "dataset" ORDER BY CASE WHEN "operationalStatus[Expanded].rawState" = 'notPresent' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END, CASE WHEN "interfaceType" = 'ethernet' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END, LENGTH("name"), "name"
